repositories.name: Faker
repositories.primary_metric: Deterministic mock PII data generation with 100+ localized country providers
repositories.production_tradeoff: Mock generation rather than statistical relational correlation modeling

repositories.name: Synthetic Data Vault (SDV)
repositories.primary_metric: CTGAN/CopulaGAN relational tabular synthesizer with Wasserstein fidelity metrics
repositories.production_tradeoff: Multi-table relational synthesis on complex schemas requires GPU or multi-core CPU

repositories.name: Distilabel
repositories.primary_metric: High-throughput LLM synthetic dataset synthesis & DPO preference pair distillation
repositories.production_tradeoff: Requires local or remote LLM endpoint (vLLM/Ollama/OpenRouter) for text synthesis

repositories.name: OpenDP (Harvard/Microsoft)
repositories.primary_metric: Mathematical differential privacy library with formal epsilon-delta bounds
repositories.production_tradeoff: Privacy budget calibration requires statistical expertise to balance utility vs noise

repositories.name: DataSynthesizer
repositories.primary_metric: Differentially private Bayesian network and correlated attribute synthesizer
repositories.production_tradeoff: High attribute cardinality can increase Bayesian network computation time
